summary: FAIL. The §7.x append mostly respects the hard boundaries: all 11 sub-gaps remain `[UNKNOWN]`, there is no explicit `[SYN]`→`[COROLLARY]` upgrade, the v0.3 `USER-APPROVED PRIORITY 2026-04-25, NOT C3-passed` banner is intact, and point 7 does disclose the symmetric+lockstep precondition for the per-trial/per-channel-use alignment. However, two fixable rigor leaks remain. First, §7.x.1 upgrades the user’s checkpoint replies into `C2 已满足`, which exceeds v0.3’s own direction-only approval boundary and should stay framed as C2-relevant evidence, not a satisfied gate. Second, §7.x.2 briefly recasts Curty 2018’s untrusted-Charlie/MDI discussion as direct support for Lemma A protocol embedding before later disclaiming that exact reduction; that still smuggles part of the `Π → ι(Π)=Π_tr` bridge that must remain open.

issues.description: §7.x.1 says the user’s `是/等价` replies plus the v0.3 direction approval mean `C2 已满足`. Under `CLAUDE.md` R0.2 and v0.3’s own banner, direction-level approval does not sign off on specific lemma wording / grading / scope. The subsection correctly keeps C1(b) at cross-reference level, but `C2 已满足` still overstates the gate state and blurs evidence vs. satisfaction.
issues.suggestion: Rewrite this as `user explicit position recorded; relevant to C2, but not treated here as full upgrade-gate satisfaction unless the user separately signs off on the specific lemma statements/scope/grading`. Keep the current `not sub-gap closure` caveat.

issues.description: Point 5.5 says Curty 2018 `直接支持 Lemma A protocol embedding 的合法性`, even though the same subsection later says Curty does not provide the trusted-relay reduction and does not walk the `Π -> ι(Π) = Π_tr` path. Curty 2018 stays in the untrusted-Charlie picture; describing it as direct support for Lemma A smuggles a cross-space / operational-link bridge that should remain `[UNKNOWN]`.
issues.suggestion: Restrict Curty 2018 to `untrusted-Charlie technical foundation / announcement-conditioned reduced-state citation / MDI-style measurement-unit robustness` and explicitly say it does not support Lemma A embedding legality or any trusted-relay reduction step.

round_recommendation: Rephrase §7.x.1 so the user replies are recorded as C1(b)/C2-relevant evidence only, not `C2 已满足`, and rewrite §7.x.2 point 5.5 so Curty 2018 stays strictly inside the untrusted-Charlie picture. No other rollback is needed if the existing `[UNKNOWN]`, banner, and point-7 caveats remain unchanged.
